fixtures.invariant: LONG bar opening below stop executes STOP_GAP at uncapped bar open at minute start
SHORT bar opening above stop executes STOP_GAP at uncapped bar open at minute start
LONG bar opening between TP1 and TP2 fills TP1_GAP_CAPPED at TP1 limit without price improvement
SHORT bar opening between TP1 and TP2 fills TP1_GAP_CAPPED at TP1 limit without price improvement
LONG bar opening beyond TP2 fills both TP1_GAP_CAPPED and TP2_GAP_CAPPED at their respective limits
SHORT bar opening beyond TP2 fills both TP1_GAP_CAPPED and TP2_GAP_CAPPED at their respective limits
LONG bar hitting STOP, TP1, and TP2 in the same minute rejects optimistic TP fills and exits full quantity at STOP
SHORT bar hitting STOP, TP1, and TP2 in the same minute rejects optimistic TP fills and exits full quantity at STOP
LONG non-gap bar reaching TP2 high fills only TP1 in that minute; TP2 deferred to subsequent minute
SHORT non-gap bar reaching TP2 low fills only TP1 in that minute; TP2 deferred to subsequent minute
When TP1 fills on opening gap, intrabar high reaching TP2 in the same minute cannot fill TP2
When TP1 fills on opening gap and bar subsequently breaches STOP intraminute, residual q2 exits at STOP
TP1 at bar close (t_settle - 1ms) reduces inventory before funding at t_settle even while TP1 ACK is at t_settle + 60s
TP1_GAP_CAPPED at exact funding timestamp (exit_at == settlement_at) precedes funding bill and charges only residual q2
Full exit at exact funding timestamp (exit_at == settlement_at) incurs zero funding bill
Funding settlement at exact entry_at timestamp is charged on full initial quantity
Funding at bar open (t) before TP1 at bar close (t + 59,999ms) charges full initial quantity q1 + q2
Bar-open fill ACKs at +60,000ms; bar-close fill (minute+59,999ms) ACKs at next-next minute open (+60,001ms)
E2 breakeven stop amendment is inactive during the minute between TP1 bar-close fill and TP1 ACK
SHORT E2 breakeven stop never loosens initial stop and activates strictly at/after TP1 ACK
LONG exact limit touch logs touch_no_fill=1 without filling; 1-tick trade-through (+0.1) fills at limit
SHORT exact limit touch logs touch_no_fill=1 without filling; 1-tick trade-through (-0.1) fills at limit
Legacy E0 primary fills on exact touch whereas E0 through requires 1-tick trade-through
fill_mode='delay' waits 1 bar after trade-through and fills when subsequent bar opens favorably
fill_mode='delay' rejects fill when next bar opens unfavorably even if high trades through again
fill_mode='unfilled' skips first confirmation bar (including opening gap) and fills on second confirmation
Odd lot multiple (0.027 BTC) splits into floor half (0.013) + remainder (0.014); float ULP accepted; non-lot rejected
Position with total notional >= 5 USDT but half-tier notional < 5 USDT raises PartialIneligible
Entry fee is charged exactly once at entry_at; allocated tier entry fees sum to fee_entry; exit fees sum across tiers
Signed funding cash equals -side * open_qty * mark_close * rate across all (+/- side) x (+/-/0 rate) combinations
At exact horizon deadline, adverse opening gap beyond stop executes STOP_GAP rather than TIME_CAP
At exact horizon deadline, favorable opening gap beyond target2 caps TIME_CAP raw exit at target2
path_eligible prospectively censors entries where entry + horizon + 1m >= fold_end across 12h, 18h, and 24h
Account replay raises ValueError if any admitted trade's exit_ack_at reaches or exceeds fold end_ms
TP1 ACK while q2 remains open does not reopen single-position gate; post-exit cooldown blocks early re-entry
Missing completed 1m Mark bar at settlement or inside fold raises ValueError
Missing or non-contiguous 1m Last bar on exit path raises ValueError
size() enforces 0.95 * min(cash, 1000) budget with worst-entry, entry fee, 1.1x exit and 12h funding reserves
Unacknowledged exit P&L is held in pending receivable until exit_ack_at and cannot pre-fund concurrent entry
Duplicate signal at same clock is blocked by position gate; duplicate tier exit in journal fails inventory conservation
Funding event supplying mark_price without mark_price_source_proven=True raises ValueError
Entry open diverging by more than 0.25 * atr_hour from decision_close is rejected
Stop on wrong side of entry or effective entry slipping past stop is rejected
Signal violating event_time + 60s <= decision_at + 60s <= entry_at raises ValueError and is not silently ignored
Mark liquidation curve raises ValueError if marked account equity drops to or below zero
Synthetic 10x/15x naive leverage triggers Mark liquidation before 1x stop and incurs gap deficit; risk-capped isolated survives
Signal generation and entry proposal are invariant to future Last/Mark/Funding mutations and strict prefix truncation
Independent Decimal audit deterministically catches cash, fee, residual qty, premature ACK, and curve tampering

worst_unknown_assumptions_ordered_by_mat.worst_credible_impact: 100% isolated margin wipeout + negative-equity bankruptcy deficit under 10x-15x naive notional scaling because W1_C04/W2_C05 1R stop distances (up to >10% of BTC price) exceed 10x/15x initial margin buffers.
worst_unknown_assumptions_ordered_by_mat.mitigation_requirement: Never multiply 1x P&L by leverage; enforce risk-budgeted isolated sizing where stop_distance + gap_buffer + MMR + fees <= max_account_risk_pct, backed by verified as-of exchange bracket tables.

worst_unknown_assumptions_ordered_by_mat.worst_credible_impact: Doubling friction from BASE (22 bps nominal RT) to STRESS (44 bps nominal RT) reduces mean net return by ~26.1 to 26.9 bps per trade; an additional +10 bps roundtrip fee tier shift reduces mean net return by another ~10.0 bps per trade, pushing E0/E1/E2 close to or below zero.
worst_unknown_assumptions_ordered_by_mat.mitigation_requirement: Require primary evaluation at STRESS (44 bps) and verifiable account VIP/maker-taker fee schedule before any TESTNET/LIVE gate.

worst_unknown_assumptions_ordered_by_mat.worst_credible_impact: Single-event discrepancy up to -350+ bps when a transient 1m wick trades through TP1/TP2 by >=1 tick but fails to fill in queue (unfilled/delay modes), converting a target fill into a later STOP or lower TIME_CAP.
worst_unknown_assumptions_ordered_by_mat.mitigation_requirement: Require L2 order-book / tick trade-through replay or conservative marketable-limit / stop-market execution assumptions.

worst_unknown_assumptions_ordered_by_mat.worst_credible_impact: Bar-open STOP_GAP executes at uncapped open price plus adverse spread/slippage; in flash crashes or liquidity halts, stop-market slippage can far exceed the 6 bps STRESS slippage proxy.
worst_unknown_assumptions_ordered_by_mat.mitigation_requirement: Enforce hard isolated margin caps and stress-test -5% to -12% bar-open gaps prior to any capital deployment.

worst_unknown_assumptions_ordered_by_mat.worst_credible_impact: Closest real TP1-to-funding settlement in 2021-2023 is 119,999 ms (0 real cases <=60s). In live execution, network/exchange ACK jitter or cancel-replace race conditions between TP1 fill and STOP quantity reduction / E2 BE amendment could cause double-fills or unhedged flips.
worst_unknown_assumptions_ordered_by_mat.mitigation_requirement: Require reduceOnly flags on all exit legs, idempotent clientOrderId tracking, and sub-second synthetic + TESTNET race-condition injection tests.

worst_unknown_assumptions_ordered_by_mat.worst_credible_impact: Bounded at <= 0.005167 bps (0.00047418 USDT) per settlement across all realized R1 funding events.
worst_unknown_assumptions_ordered_by_mat.mitigation_requirement: Low financial materiality on 1x spot-equivalent notional; log exact exchange funding settlement receipts in any future live/testnet shadow logger.
